detect_test_concurrency() {
  local cores load1
  if command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    cores=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg 2>/dev/null | awk '{print int($2)}')
  elif [ -r /proc/loadavg ]; then
    cores=$(nproc 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/loadavg)
  fi
  if [ -n "$cores" ] && [ -n "$load1" ] && [ "$load1" -ge $((cores / 2)) ]; then
    echo 2
  fi
  # Empty output on an idle box = no --concurrency flag (package defaults).
}

detect_test_concurrency() {
  local cores load1
  if command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    cores=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg 2>/dev/null | awk '{print int($2)}')
  elif [ -r /proc/loadavg ]; then
    cores=$(nproc 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/loadavg)
  fi
  if [ -n "$cores" ] && [ -n "$load1" ] && [ "$load1" -ge $((cores / 2)) ]; then
    echo 2
  fi
  # Empty output on an idle box = no --concurrency flag (package defaults).
}

detect_test_concurrency() {
  local cores load1
  if command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    cores=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg 2>/dev/null | awk '{print int($2)}')
  elif [ -r /proc/loadavg ]; then
    cores=$(nproc 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/loadavg)
  fi
  if [ -n "$cores" ] && [ -n "$load1" ] && [ "$load1" -ge $((cores / 2)) ]; then
    echo 2
  fi
  # Empty output on an idle box = no --concurrency flag (package defaults).
}

detect_test_concurrency() {
  local cores load1
  if command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    cores=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg 2>/dev/null | awk '{print int($2)}')
  elif [ -r /proc/loadavg ]; then
    cores=$(nproc 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/loadavg)
  fi
  if [ -n "$cores" ] && [ -n "$load1" ] && [ "$load1" -ge $((cores / 2)) ]; then
    echo 2
  fi
  # Empty output on an idle box = no --concurrency flag (package defaults).
}

# gh-1603 rework — validation CI red head fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI was red on head `cc634050` (2 failed checks):
  - **`CRAP + duplication` (guards leg)** — failed at the *CRAP ratchet* step:
    `Max CRAP: 15.00 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`. The offender was
    `AgentCli.runHeadless` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart:1845`): the gh-1603
    headless changes (the `endedOnEmptyCompletion` probe — 4 conditions — plus
    the `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker check and the terminal `switch` on
    `terminalStopReason`) raised the method's cyclomatic complexity to 15,
    which reads CRAP 15.00 at the 100% coverage the merged CI lcov reports.
    The ratchet in `crap4dart.yaml` is pinned at 12.0 and per repo policy
    (`AGENTS.md`: "only tighten") may never be raised to fit new code.
  - **`Quality gate`** — red only as the aggregate over the guards leg
    (`Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`); every other leg
    (static, test-core, coverage, flutter, platform builds, security) passed.
- No open review threads on the PR (`pr_discussions_raw.json`:
  `{"threads": []}`) — nothing to reply to; `outputs/review_replies.json`
  carries an empty `replies` list.

## Approach

- Behavior-preserving refactor of `runHeadless`, following the repo's own
  precedent for exactly this situation (`agent_cli_hep_io.dart` exists "so
  `AgentCli.runHeadless` stays under the CRAP gate"): the gh-1603 exit-code
  policy moved into a new `part of 'agent_cli.dart'` file as an
  `AgentCliHeadlessExit` extension with two cohesive helpers:
  - `_settledOnEmptyCompletion()` — the "did the run settle on an empty
    completion" probe (is-AssistantMessage + not-error + not-aborted +
    `isEmptyAssistantCompletion`), documented as only valid before post-run
    compaction folds the transcript (issue #413);
  - `_headlessExitCode({endedOnEmptyCompletion, terminalStopReason})` —
    prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and returns 1 for an
    unfinished session, else maps `error → 1`, `aborted → 130`, `_ → 0`.
- `runHeadless` now calls the two helpers; the gh-1603 semantics are
  byte-identical (same marker text, same exit codes, same probe timing).
- RED→GREEN was run against the failing gate itself: a targeted coverage run
  reproduced the ratchet failure with `runHeadless` at CC 15 (16.04 CRAP at
  partial coverage), and after the refactor the same measurement showed CC 11.
  The CRAP ratchet is the regression test for this class of CI failure; the
  behavior contract is pinned by the PR's existing tests (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — registered the new part; `runHeadless` now
  delegates the gh-1603 empty-settle probe and the final exit-code mapping to
  the helpers (−30/+9 lines; no behavior change).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_headless_exit.dart` — **new** `part of` file with the
  `AgentCliHeadlessExit` extension (`_settledOnEmptyCompletion`,
  `_headlessExitCode`), same layout as `agent_cli_hep_io.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- **Full suite (post-fix, with coverage)**: `dart test --coverage
  --exclude-tags integration` → **10712 passed, 10 skipped** (the
  environment-gated live legs), 0 failures, plus the 3 integration-tagged
  `jsr` files CI's test-core leg includes → 45 passed. Includes the PR's own
  gh-1603 suites: `test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart` (nudge
  transparency), `test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart` (nudge-carrying retries,
  HT6UsCc shape), `test/cli/agent_cli_empty_continuation_test.dart` (headless
  nudge budget, `__FA_INCOMPLETE` + exit 1, distinct hiccup-exhaustion exit).
- **Guards leg re-run locally, step by step (CI parity)**:
  - CRAP ratchet (`crap4dart analyze` over the merged lcov):
    `Max CRAP: 12.00 — OK (threshold: 12.00)` — `runHeadless` now **11.00 @
    100% cov** (was 15.00); helpers 4.00 / 2.00. Back at main's baseline.
  - Quality gates (`crap4dart check --baseline`): exit 0 (3 passed / 1
    pre-existing non-blocking duplication WARN, identical count on the PR
    head).
  - Loc scope gate (`check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc`):
    exit 0 — 857 files within limits.
  - Duplication (`jscpd`, lib/): 0.79% < 1.0% threshold.
  - Cross-module duplication ratchet (`ci_fast_gate.sh --stages dupx`): OK.
- `dart analyze`: no new findings (the only errors/warnings on the tree are
  78 pre-existing ones in the standalone `office_addin/dart` nested package,
  byte-identical with and without the change; CI's static leg is green).

CI re-runs automatically on the next push; every leg that failed is now
locally green.

{"content":"# gh-1603 rework — validation CI red head fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI was red on head `cc634050` (2 failed checks):
  - **`CRAP + duplication` (guards leg)** — failed at the *CRAP ratchet* step:
    `Max CRAP: 15.00 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)`. The offender was
    `AgentCli.runHeadless` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart:1845`): the gh-1603
    headless changes (the `endedOnEmptyCompletion` probe — 4 conditions — plus
    the `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker check and the terminal `switch` on
    `terminalStopReason`) raised the method's cyclomatic complexity to 15,
    which reads CRAP 15.00 at the 100% coverage the merged CI lcov reports.
    The ratchet in `crap4dart.yaml` is pinned at 12.0 and per repo policy
    (`AGENTS.md`: "only tighten") may never be raised to fit new code.
  - **`Quality gate`** — red only as the aggregate over the guards leg
    (`Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`); every other leg
    (static, test-core, coverage, flutter, platform builds, security) passed.
- No open review threads on the PR (`pr_discussions_raw.json`:
  `{"threads": []}`) — nothing to reply to; `outputs/review_replies.json`
  carries an empty `replies` list.

## Approach

- Behavior-preserving refactor of `runHeadless`, following the repo's own
  precedent for exactly this situation (`agent_cli_hep_io.dart` exists "so
  `AgentCli.runHeadless` stays under the CRAP gate"): the gh-1603 exit-code
  policy moved into a new `part of 'agent_cli.dart'` file as an
  `AgentCliHeadlessExit` extension with two cohesive helpers:
  - `_settledOnEmptyCompletion()` — the "did the run settle on an empty
    completion" probe (is-AssistantMessage + not-error + not-aborted +
    `isEmptyAssistantCompletion`), documented as only valid before post-run
    compaction folds the transcript (issue #413);
  - `_headlessExitCode({endedOnEmptyCompletion, terminalStopReason})` —
    prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and returns 1 for an
    unfinished session, else maps `error → 1`, `aborted → 130`, `_ → 0`.
- `runHeadless` now calls the two helpers; the gh-1603 semantics are
  byte-identical (same marker text, same exit codes, same probe timing).
- RED→GREEN was run against the failing gate itself: a targeted coverage run
  reproduced the ratchet failure with `runHeadless` at CC 15 (16.04 CRAP at
  partial coverage), and after the refactor the same measurement showed CC 11.
  The CRAP ratchet is the regression test for this class of CI failure; the
  behavior contract is pinned by the PR's existing tests (see Test Coverage).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — registered the new part; `runHeadless` now
  delegates the gh-1603 empty-settle probe and the final exit-code mapping to
  the helpers (−30/+9 lines; no behavior change).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_headless_exit.dart` — **new** `part of` file with the
  `AgentCliHeadlessExit` extension (`_settledOnEmptyCompletion`,
  `_headlessExitCode`), same layout as `agent_cli_hep_io.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- **Full suite (post-fix, with coverage)**: `dart test --coverage
  --exclude-tags integration` → **10712 passed, 10 skipped** (the
  environment-gated live legs), 0 failures, plus the 3 integration-tagged

  - Quality gates (`crap4dart check --baseline`): exit 0 (3 passed / 1
